thread:
erin: Heads-up team  planning a short social push for the Helios webinar next week. We want 4 touchpoints across X + LinkedIn: teaser, deep-dive invite, guest highlight, last-call. Need assets + final copy + tracking by Tue noon so we can QA.

leo: OK. Who's handling hero assets and video cutdowns? Specs?

erin: Hero: 1200x627 for LinkedIn, 1200x675 for X OG image. Need 1:1 thumb 800x800 for share cards. Video: 15s social cut, 30s teaser, silent 30s for paid. Also a 3-slide carousel for LI. I'll upload to `/Marketing/Campaigns/helios/assets`.

priya: I'll write copy. Planning two tones: engineer-first and product-first. Will post drafts here by Mon morning. Any prohibited wording?

nate: Legal prefers avoiding absolute superlatives. Use "measurable improvements" or "industry-leading patterns" instead of hard numbers until we have partner approvals. Also check partner handles before tagging.

erin: Good call. Core message: "Make inference predictable: high throughput, consistent latency, and cost controls across hosted/dedicated/private." CTA: "Reserve your spot".

jules: For lead tracking, let's append UTMs: `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=helios_series&utm_content={post}`. SDRs want the post type in utm_content (teaser|invite|guest|lastcall). Routing: push leads to queue `helios-webinar`.

ops-bot: Short links generated:
- teaser: https://rwd.link/helios1
- invite: https://rwd.link/helios2
- guest: https://rwd.link/helios3
- lastcall: https://rwd.link/helios4
All include base UTMs; replace `{post}` with the post slug before scheduling.

leo: Scheduling windows suggestion: X posts at 9am PT, LI at 11am PT. Guest highlight best at 2pm PT. Thoughts?

priya: Sounds good. I'll tailor first sentences: short punch for X, more context and carousel for LI.

erin: Design deadline = Tue 10am. Can design hit that? If not, fallback = single image + 15s clip.

leo: I'll flag design. Also request to product marketing: can we get short guest bios and headshots by Mon EOD to prep the guest highlight post?

nate: Paid boost request: allocate $600 for the invite post targeted at dev/platform audiences in NA/EMEA. Approve?

jules: Approve from social budget. Please submit the boost form with creative variant labeled `helios_paid_invite`.

priya: Draft copy (engineer tone):
```
X teaser: "Curious how teams keep inference stable under burst load? Join our Helios webinar to see runtime and routing patterns that improve latency and cost. RSVP: <short link>"
```
LI invite (product tone):
```
"Helios: Strategies to serve LLMs reliably at scale. Join us for practical guidance on latency SLOs, cost levers, and deployment choices. Reserve your spot: <short link>"
```

erin: Nice. Replace "improve latency" with "reduce latency variability" in the engineer line. Also avoid specific ms claims.

leo: Engagement plan after post: 1) react to top comments within 1 hour, 2) capture good questions and have host reply in thread, 3) route requests for product demos to #sales-ops. Can we commit resources for T+1 hour coverage?

jules: SDR routing confirmed. Leads will be tagged `lead_source=social_helios` and queued. Follow-ups by SDRs within 24 hours.

ops-bot: Scheduler entries prepared (draft):
```
{ "platform": "linkedin", "time": "2026-05-04T18:00:00Z", "draft_id": "HLX-501" }
{ "platform": "x", "time": "2026-05-04T16:00:00Z", "draft_id": "HLX-502" }
{ "platform": "linkedin", "time": "2026-05-06T18:00:00Z", "draft_id": "HLX-503" }
{ "platform": "x", "time": "2026-05-07T19:00:00Z", "draft_id": "HLX-504" }
```
Please confirm times are acceptable; these are in UTC.

priya: Times OK. I'll format final copy to fit character limits and include partner handles in the invite only after partner confirmation.

erin: Partners to confirm: @EdgeInfra and @OpenModelLabs. Nate, can you ping them for permission to tag?

nate: On it. Will DM legal to pre-check the high-level bullets for the landing page where we might use comparative numbers.

leo: One more ask  can video craft supply an MP4 with no captions and square 1:1 silent version for ads? That performs better in feed.

erin: Yes please. Also need a GIF (loop of product UI) for the LI carousel cover.

jules: Once assets are uploaded, I'll swap in UTMs on the short links and update draft IDs with final URLs. After publish I'll post live tracking sheet with click/conversion SOV.

priya: I'll post the copy variants and creatives checklist by Mon 9am.

erin: Final items for Tue noon handoff: assets in drive, copy per platform, short links with utm_content set, partner tag approvals, paid boost form submitted, scheduler draft confirmed. Marking this thread as canonical for Helios social planning. :sun_with_face:
